text.p: L.H. Friend, Weinress, Frankson & Presson Inc said Thursday it initiated coverage of CTC Communications Corp with a buy rating.
-- The investment banking/research firm said a drop in the company's share price has created a buying opportunity.
-- CTC provides long distance and local phone services and telecom account management services.
-- Frien, Weinress analyst Steven Kornfield said reduced commissions and increased investments hindered revenue and earnings growth last year but called the slowdown temporary.
-- "We believe this temporary slowdown in growth and the corresponding 50 percent drop in CTC's share price has created a buying opportunity," he said in a report.
-- He set a target price for CTC of $16 a share.
